optimizedDescription.value: Define Ladybug `GraphStore`: config-rooted persistence, schema/search, safe Cypher, transactional bulk indexing, incremental state.

optimizedContext.value:
# Ladybug Graph Store
## Rules
- `LadybugGraphStore` implements `GraphStore`; backend id `ladybug`; native readiness deferred to `open()`; `close()` idempotent.
- Persist DB/lock/WAL under `{configPath}/graph`; scratch CSV `{configPath}/tmp`; create dirs; clean scratch after run.
- `recreate()`: discard Ladybug graph + owned companions; rotate `storage.epoch`; reopen/rebuild. Callers use provider semantics, never delete files.
- Persist `File`, `Symbol`, `Spec`, `Document`, `Meta`; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; `COVERS_SYMBOL` retains stale metadata.
- FTS: `symbol_fts` (`searchName`, `comment`), `spec_fts` (`title`, `description`, `content`), `document_fts` (content + paths); trigram source-content index ≥3-char queries. `Document` FTS primary discovery; persisted `File` content not searchable category.
- FTS query: sanitized expanded tokens joined `OR`; supplement every candidate set with identity hits; rank exact canonical > exact token > prefix > suffix > component > substring > content; more matching identity tokens wins; snippets/1-based ranges.
- Externally derived Cypher: `conn.prepare`, `conn.execute`, `$param`, `Record<string, LbugValue>` only. `conn.query` only DDL, compile-time constants, internal COPY/admin paths.
- One indexing run: one transaction/session, bounded CSV `COPY`, one commit, one semantic/content FTS rebuild; no chunk rebuild. Set-based endpoint validation.
- Persist `IndexedInputObservation`, workspace/global latches, VCS evidence, compact incremental facts, case precedence, bounded ambiguity, exact-file normalization, total/omitted matches.
- Indexed structured workspace/surface/name/symbol-space/owner/member-form/exported-name fields drive lookup/ranking; never parse/substr-rank serialized canonical ids. Shared complete/raw/expanded plan filters before candidate limits; deterministic order; bounded short-query fallback; Code Graph verifies occurrences, suppression, per-file caps.
- Schema upgrade exactly once (normally `10`→`11`); incompatible reads reject; repair destructively recreates, rotates generation, rebuilds FTS before ready.
## Constraints
- Infrastructure adapter; consumers use `code-graph:graph-store`.
- All persisted/scratch artifacts rooted `configPath`; `ladybug` stable backend id.
